# `Q-2-59` — Text after angle-bracket link destination

> An angle-bracket link destination `<...>` must be followed by `)` or
> a quoted title.

## What this means

A link or image target can be wrapped in angle brackets so that it may
contain spaces:

```markdown
![](<my file.png>)
[text](<my file.html> "a title")
```

Once the closing `>` is reached, the target is complete. Only the
closing `)`, or whitespace and a title in double quotes, may follow it.

## Why this happens

- **Part of the path left outside the brackets**, often a file
  extension:

  ```markdown
  ![](<my file>.png)
  ```

- **A title without quotes:**

  ```markdown
  [text](<my file.html> a title)
  ```

## How to fix

Keep the whole path inside the brackets, and quote any title:

```markdown
![](<my file.png>)
[text](<my file.html> "a title")
```

## Related errors

- [`Q-2-33`](Q-2-33.qmd) — spaces in a link target written without
  angle brackets.
